newsitem.title: USA: RAC's Firstplus files shelf for $1.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: RAC's Firstplus files shelf for $1.2 bln.

text.p: Firstplus Investment Corp, a unit of RAC Financial Group Inc, filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commisssion for up to $1,240,625,000 in asset-backed notes.
The company said net proceeds will be applied to simultaneous purchase of the loan assets included in the related trust or to reimburse the amounts previously used to effect such purchases.

Proceeds will also be applied to the costs of carrying the loan assets until sale of such series and to pay other expenses connected with pooling the loan assets and issuing such series, the company said in the filing.
